name: start_scratch
description: Start a scratch project: a new local git repository in your workspace, to build and test something in when the person has named no repository yet (or before one exists). Write the files with write_file, apply_patch or delegate_to_opencode and run the real checks with run_checks, passing `repo` with the project's name when the workspace has more than one slot. A scratch project stays for this conversation: the next tasks of it find the project again, and it goes after days with no task in the conversation. Nothing in it reaches a repository unless it is published to one the person names, with publish_scratch. Tell the person so. Calling it again with the same name returns the project and what it holds.

name.description: Name of the project, which is also the name of its directory (`repo` in the other tools): lowercase letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, starting with a letter or a digit, at most 64 characters, not ending in `.git`. Leave out for `scratch`.
